The '''Artorias resistance''' was a resistance cell established on [[Artorias]]. They resisted the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] occupation during and after the [[Battle of Artorias]]. It was led by the Artorian [[King/Legends|king]], [[Caled Galfridian]], from a [[Artorian safe haven|hidden base]] at the bottom of the [[Great Sea of Artorias]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Artorias|Artorian]] [[King/Legends|king]], [[Caled Galfridian]] had a [[Artorian safe haven|hidden base]] established on the bottom of the [[Great Sea of Artorias]] to defend against a possible attack by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. However, the war ended before it could be used.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5">[[Invasion 5|''Invasion'' 5]]</ref>

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Artorias|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Artorias was unprepared and quickly defeated. Many Artorians were killed or captured by the Yuuzhan Vong, while the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] managed to evacuate many others. King Galfridian, unwilling to leave his planet behind, chose to stay behind with a small group.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 1" /> Among them was [[Dulac]], who was wounded and captured before the group reached their hidden base.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 1" /><ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 3">[[Invasion 3|''Invasion'' 3]]</ref>

From their hidden base the Artorias resistance disrupted the [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]] of the planet by blowing up Yuuzhan Vong structures and killing many of the Yuuzhan Vong sentries in the process. Despite the Yuuzhan Vong's thorough search methods they could not put an end to the resistance's attacks. Replacements were needed for the dead sentries and guards from the [[slaveship]] [[Heart of Artorias|''Tsam P'ah'']] were sent, which lead to a [[Revolt aboard the Tsam P'ah|revolt]] aboard the ship. At the same time the resistance group managed to free Dulac and bring him to their hidden base.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 4" />

Meanwhile, [[Finn Galfridian]] had learned Dulac actually was a Yuuzhan Vong wearing an [[ooglith masquer]] and raced back to Artorias.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 5" /><ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues 2">[[Invasion: Rescues 2|''Invasion: Rescues'' 2]]</ref> He was too late, however, as Dulac had already revealed himself to the king and attacked him.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues 2" />
